newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends near lows, support intact.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends near lows, support intact.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled near the day's lows on residual speculative liquidation and selling of the October/March spread, market sources said.

The October/March spread narrowed to 0.16 compared to 0.19 at Friday's close while the October contract, down for the fourth consecutive day, managed to hold above key support seen at 11.50. Below 11.50, the contract could sink to between 11.25 and 11.00, market sources said.
March also held Friday's low of 11.35, forming a double bottom on the charts.
"The close near the lows is not encouraging for the bulls," one broker said. "On the other hand, October has taken the selling quite well and we may see prices higher tomorrow."
Dealers also noted producer and trade buying in the March and May contracts, and speculative selling under 11.35 basis March.
October eased 0.07 on the day to close at 11.57, having ranged from 11.68 to 11.55. March finished 0.04 lower at 11.41, while the back months settled 0.02 lower to 0.11 higher.

LCE white sugar futures, now trading under LIFFE, settled lower on the first day of the December contract as the spot month. December eased $6.60 on the day to close at $331.90, while the back months went out $4.80 to $2.60 weaker.
